title: Second Thoughts are Best: Learning to Re-Align With Human Values from Text Edits

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language model outputs against normative ethical and moral benchmark datasets (Moral Stories, Moral Integrity Corpus, ETHICS-Deontology) to measure the generation of prosocial versus antisocial behaviors and alignment with deontological principles using human evaluation and automated metrics.

Conducting Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression on human evaluation results to determine if human annotators' political party affiliations significantly influence their value judgments and alignment scoring.

Using Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression to assess whether human annotators' demographic and socioeconomic factors (gender, race, age, education, and income) impact their evaluations of what constitutes human value alignment.
